Job Details


**About Salesforce**

Salesforce is the \#1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.


Ready to level\-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.


**Overview**


Salesforce is seeking a QA Engineer (MTS) to design, build, and maintain the automated testing and evidence validation systems that support our Internal Audit \& Evaluation (IAE) program. This role is ideal for a QA Engineer who wants to apply their craft to a highleverage problem: turning internal audit evidence collection from a manual, error prone, screenshot chasing exercise into an engineered system of automated control tests, continuous evidence validation, and reproducible audit trails.  



  

You will help build the test frameworks, validation pipelines, and quality gates that verify our systems are producing accurate, complete, and auditready evidence that meets IAE requirements. You will test and validate that automated controls behave as specified, that collected evidence maps correctly to control requirements, and that compliance data is trustworthy end to end.  



  

**Responsibilities**

* Design and build automated control test suites: Create test frameworks (Apex tests, integration tests, end\-to\-end validation) that verify controls and their evidence outputs behave correctly across the compliance tooling portfolio.
* Automate evidence validation: Build validation pipelines that continuously check compliance evidence for completeness, freshness, accuracy, and correct mapping to control requirements as it flows through the collection process.
* Translate compliance requirements into test specifications: Turn compliance and Salesforce Security Standards (SFSS) requirements into machine executable test cases, evidence acceptance criteria, and pass/fail assertions.
* Build evidence integrity and regression testing: Detect compliance drift, broken evidence lineage, stale artifacts, and control regressions before they reach an auditor.
* Test platform integrations: Validate data flowing from enterprise systems (SIEM, cloud providers, HRIS, ticketing, GUS) into the GRC data model via Salesforce APIs, Platform Events, and Named Credentials confirming evidence arrives complete and untampered.
* Develop quality dashboards and reporting: Build Lightning experiences and CRM Analytics dashboards that surface test coverage, evidence health, validation failures, and remediation status in real time.
* Establish CI/CD quality gates: Integrate automated compliance tests into SFDX/CI pipelines so evidence quality is verified on every change.
* Partner with IAE: Validate test logic, evidence requirements, and control coverage against IAE expectations and SOC 2, ISO 27001, PCI DSS, and other standards; help auditors trust the evidence the system produces.
* Partner with engineering: Identify gaps in current validation pipelines and provide support for the development of new pipelines where they are not yet available, ensuring comprehensive evidence collection.

**Required Qualifications**

* 5\+ years in QA / test engineering, including automated testing on the Salesforce Platform: Apex unit and integration tests, SOQL/SOSL, and validation of Flows, Platform Events, and Salesforce APIs (REST/SOAP/Bulk/Streaming)
* Strong test automation skills: proficiency building maintainable automated test suites; working proficiency in SQL and Python for data validation, test tooling, and evidence pipeline verification
* Evidence and data validation: experience validating data integrity, completeness, and correctness across ETL/integration pipelines and canonical data models
* Ability to write efficient, reliable tests and validation logic that run within platform limits and at scale
* Requirements translation: demonstrated ability to translate complex compliance requirements into precise, testable specifications and automated assertions
* Compliance familiarity: understanding of control testing, evidence collection, and audit requirements (SOC 2, ISO 27001, PCI DSS, etc.), including compliance frameworks and requirements, or strong appetite to learn
* Ownership mindset: end\-to\-end responsibility for quality outcomes; proactively find defects, gaps, and evidence risks before they escalate to audit findings
* Quality rigor and collaboration: strong engineering fundamentals, attention to edge cases, open information sharing, and constructive technical debate

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Salesforce certifications: Platform Developer I, Administrator, or relevant QA/architect certifications
* Test automation frameworks: Selenium, Provar, UTAM, Jest, or similar for Salesforce/LWC testing
* CRM Analytics / Tableau for quality and coverage reporting
* DevOps / CI on Salesforce: SFDX, source driven development, CI/CD pipelines (Copado, GitHub Actions), automated test gating
* Compliance as Code / policy as code testing (OPA, Checkov) and evidence as code validation
* Cloud platform experience (AWS, GCP, Hyperforce) and their compliance/security evidence sources
* Python for test automation, data validation scripts, and evidence pipeline verification
* Experience with Agentforce, Einstein, or LLM frameworks particularly for validating AIgenerated evidence, control assessments, or audit narratives

**Company Details**:

We are **Beesolver Technology Pvt Ltd**, a product\-centric company founded in **2014**, with a team of approximately **130–140 employees**. You can learn more about us at **https://www.beesolvertechnology.com/**  
We build innovative technology solutions across a range of domains — including **web and mobile application development, cloud\-native solutions, custom software, business analytics, information management, IT consulting, software testing, UI/UX design, and digital marketing**.

**Job Description:** 

**Experience Required: 4\+ Years**  
**Location \- Mohali** 

**Required qualifications:** 

We are looking for an engineer whose AI work is recent but whose engineering foundation is not.

The AI tooling era is young; the habits that make software reliable in production are not.

* 1\+ year building AI\-powered solutions that real users depend on: agents, RAG applications, copilots, or LLM\-backed automations, with something you can walk us through end to end.

* **Experience integrating complex transactional business systems. ERP is ideal, but fintech, logistics, or e\-commerce platforms count, along with the data messiness that comes with them.**
* Multi\-tenant delivery experience. You have shipped something that had to be configured, deployed, and supported across more than one client environment, with role\-based access and genuine data isolation.
* **Sound, secure development practices: version control, code review, automated testing, CI/CD, secrets management, least\-privilege access, and care with client data.**
* Clear written and spoken English, documentation discipline, and the communication skills to be put in front of a client.
* **Self\-direction. You work from outcomes rather than tickets, ask good questions early, and are comfortable being the person who figures it out.**

jobs.title: Backend Engineer
jobs.description:
**About Atlys**


Our mission is to enable every person on Earth to travel freely.


Travel should feel exciting. Instead, too much of it is still defined by paperwork, uncertainty, and processes that were never designed for travellers.


Atlys is changing that.


We're building an AI\-first platform that removes friction and uncertainty from travel. To date, we've processed visas for 1M\+ travellers across 127 countries. But we're still early.

**The Role**


We're looking for a **Backend Engineer** to build the services and systems that power visa processing for travellers around the world, from the APIs behind our apps to the pipelines that file every application.


You'll design and own Python services that connect government portals, payment providers, document pipelines and our AI systems, and keep them fast, reliable and correct as we scale across countries and volume.


This role is for someone with a strong engineering foundation who loves clean systems design, and who gets as much satisfaction from a service that quietly works at peak load as from shipping a new feature.

**The Job**

* **Build the core platform** by designing and shipping Python services and APIs that power applications, payments, document handling and order tracking across 127 countries.
* **Integrate with the real world** by building robust integrations with government portals, embassies, payment gateways and partners, handling retries, rate limits, flaky endpoints and ever\-changing rules gracefully.
* **Scale for volume** by designing data models, queues and async workflows that hold up through peak travel seasons and sudden spikes in demand.
* **Put AI into production** by working closely with our AI team to turn LLM\-powered agents and document intelligence pipelines into reliable, observable backend services.
* **Own systems end to end** by taking work from design to production, including deployment, monitoring, alerting and incident follow\-ups, with a high bar for testing and security since we handle passports and financial documents.

**The Ideal Candidate**


You'll likely thrive in this role if you:

* Have 2\-5 years of backend engineering experience, building and running production systems at meaningful scale.
* Are exceptionally strong in Python and have shipped production services with frameworks such as FastAPI, Django or Flask.
* Have solid fundamentals in databases and distributed systems, including PostgreSQL, Redis, message queues (Kafka, RabbitMQ, SQS or Celery), caching and async processing.
* Are comfortable with cloud infrastructure and modern tooling such as AWS or GCP, Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD and observability stacks.
* Have exposure to browser automation (Playwright, Selenium), integrating LLM APIs, or building in fintech, travel or other high\-compliance domains (a strong plus).

**Here's what you can expect:**

* Competitive compensation and equity so you participate in the value you help create.
* Comprehensive health insurance covering you and your family, plus annual preventive health check\-up on us.
* A thoughtful leave policy with paid time off and company holidays, because great work also requires real time off.
* Lunch, high tea and dinner at the office, so the basics are taken care of while we build together.
* Learning \& development credits to invest in courses, books, conferences and tools that help you get better at your craft.
* Relocation support to make moving closer to the team as seamless as possible.
* Great tools to do your best work, including high\-spec equipment and software.
* An office designed for more than just work, with pickleball, table tennis, PlayStation, an arcade game room, an F1 simulator and even a full flight simulator.


Our values shape how we make decisions, work together and build for travelers. The bar is high, the pace is fast, and the way we work is deliberate. Read them before you apply. If this environment energizes you, you'll probably thrive here. If it doesn't, it's better to know that upfront.

**Come build the intelligence layer for global travel**

* Partner with engineering: Identify gaps in current validation pipelines and provide support for the development of new pipelines where they are not yet available, ensuring comprehensive evidence collection.

**Company Details**:

We are **Beesolver Technology Pvt Ltd**, a product\-centric company founded in **2014**, with a team of approximately **130–140 employees**. You can learn more about us at **https://www.beesolvertechnology.com/**  
We build innovative technology solutions across a range of domains — including **web and mobile application development, cloud\-native solutions, custom software, business analytics, information management, IT consulting, software testing, UI/UX design, and digital marketing**.

**Job Description:** 

**Experience Required: 4\+ Years**  
**Location \- Mohali** 

**Required qualifications:** 

We are looking for an engineer whose AI work is recent but whose engineering foundation is not.

The AI tooling era is young; the habits that make software reliable in production are not.

* 1\+ year building AI\-powered solutions that real users depend on: agents, RAG applications, copilots, or LLM\-backed automations, with something you can walk us through end to end.
* 4\+ years of software engineering overall, with production depth in at least one of Python, Java, TypeScript, or C\#, and the ability to stand up a backend service on your own (FastAPI, Spring Boot, Node, or similar). Not everything we build lives inside Infor.
* **Strong API skills: integrating REST APIs, auth flows (OAuth2, API keys, service accounts), webhooks, pagination, rate limits, and retries, plus the patience to debug when the contract and the reality disagree.**
* Hands\-on experience with MCP or comparable agent\-tooling patterns, connecting AI systems to external tools and data, and ideally building those connectors yourself.
* **Practical RAG and agent orchestration experience: chunking, embeddings, vector stores, retrieval that respects who is allowed to see what, and a real method for evaluating whether the output is any good.**
* Asynchronous and event\-driven work: queues and background workers, idempotent processing, retries, and dead\-letter handling. Integrations fail, and yours should fail safely.
* **Experience integrating complex transactional business systems. ERP is ideal, but fintech, logistics, or e\-commerce platforms count, along with the data messiness that comes with them.**
* Multi\-tenant delivery experience. You have shipped something that had to be configured, deployed, and supported across more than one client environment, with role\-based access and genuine data isolation.
* **Sound, secure development practices: version control, code review, automated testing, CI/CD, secrets management, least\-privilege access, and care with client data.**
* Clear written and spoken English, documentation discipline, and the communication skills to be put in front of a client.
* **Self\-direction. You work from outcomes rather than tickets, ask good questions early, and are comfortable being the person who figures it out.**

Pay: Up to ₹1,670,696\.30 per year

* Flexible schedule
* Paid time off
* Provident Fund
